name: Birdseye
description: One dot per tile with a smaller one nested inside it in a second ink.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--color1); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 34%, transparent 34%) 0 0 / 25% 25%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 34%, transparent 34%) 0 0 / 25% 25%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 15%, transparent 15%) 0 0 / 25% 25%; mask: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, #000 15%, transparent 15%) 0 0 / 25% 25%; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
